name: ccmaf-waiting-notifier
description: Tells you when Claude is waiting on you (permission prompt, question) or has finished a long turn: a toast plus a sound or terminal bell.

thresholdSeconds.title: Long-turn threshold (seconds)
thresholdSeconds.description: Notify when a turn finishes after taking longer than this many seconds.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play a sound with each notification.

soundVia.title: Sound via
soundVia.description: clip: play the bundled chime (macOS only). bell: ring the terminal bell / notification channel. both: do both.
